edge_lab.verdict: No edge. Across 226 settled legs priced at the same instant, Kalshi and the bookmaker differ by 0.8c on average and never by more than 5c (0% of legs). Only 0 legs ever cleared spread plus fee, so there is no trade here to take. The +14.4% ROI the retrospective test showed was entirely the 8-hour lookahead in that test, not a real mispricing.
